notes: Four food-truck tools serve Austria with a price on their own site: GastroDok (actually run by a Vienna company, IGCP Capital Partners GmbH; 29 €/month or 290 €/year incl. USt), gastro25 (DACH; 69 €/month net; pricing page tagged hreflang de-AT), Liefersoft (site names Österreich; GOLD with webshop ab 129 €/month net at 60 months, 299 € onboarding), FoxiFood (Austria listed on its country-terms page; 0 €/month, 0,45 € per order paid by the customer). GASTRODIGITAL is a restaurant tool that says only 'DACH-Raum' (99 €/month flat or 0,49 € per order; VAT not stated). For these five, prices, features and eligibility quotes are carried over from today's DE check (raw/DE.json, same pages, same day); for AT only the country evidence was fetched new, and the prices pages of GASTRODIGITAL, GastroDok and gastro25 were re-read and their price quotes found again. None shows an Austria-specific price; all prices are the German-site EUR prices. Liefersoft quotes come from its JS bundle (single-page app), as noted in DE.json. FoxiFood's country quote is on an English-language legal page; it does not name Austria in the sentence itself, but 'Österreich / Austria' is the first entry in the list right under it. GastroDok's footer quote names only 'Wien'; its JSON-LD (not visible text) says 'für Gastronomiebetriebe in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz' with areaServed DE/AT/CH. GastroOnline & Winorder (stored, Austrian) was in maintenance (HTTP 503) on both tries; marked unreadable, recheck later. Two searches found no other Austria-made pre-order tool with an own-site price (results were directories, app stores, marketplaces, and a lockdown-era WKO OÖ 'klickundguat' PDF, not followed). SumUp, Zettle and Lightspeed were not needed and not checked.
